description: Source file defining the IOSGatewayChatTransport struct which implements OpenClawChatTransport for iOS platform. Contains asynchronous methods for managing chat sessions, sending messages, retrieving history, and handling WebSocket events in a chat application.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: Implements chat transport functionalities for iOS using a GatewayNodeSession.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Sends a request to abort a specific chat run session asynchronously.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chat sessions, optionally limited by a number.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Placeholder for setting an active session key; currently does nothing.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a chat session identified by sessionKey.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Cleans up or compacts a chat session identified by sessionKey.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Fetches chat history for a given session asynchronously.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments, logs the operation, and handles response or error.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway connection.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of chat transport events such as tick, seqGap, health, chat, and agent.
